title: Karim Khan Is Ousted as I.C.C. Chief Prosecutor Over Sexual Misconduct
summary_full: The International Criminal Court, which prosecutes some of the world’s most serious crimes, has been in limbo for years over the allegations against Karim A. A. Khan, its top prosecutor.
